Q: How do I make the first letter of a string uppercase in JavaScript? A:

I wanted to give it a shot. You can try out the snippet 🙂⚡

const C = (T) => T.split(" ").map((W) => [W[0].toUpperCase(), W.slice(1)].join("")).join(" ");
<input type="text" value="hey there! whats up?" id="I">
<button onclick="document.getElementById('L').textContent = C(document.getElementById('I').value)">capitalize</button>
<p>
<label id="L"></label>

Q: wireshark capture filter for specific UDP bytes A:

To check the UDP payload 3rd and 4th bytes:

udp and data[2:2]==8C:61

To check if the payload contains 8C:61 anywhere:

udp and data contains 8C:61
